sourceText: Close Tier-C (strong host-neutral) via a cheap proof-of-mechanism first; M0 is to write the threat model plus key-management decision and the execution plan, before any M1/M2 build.
normalizedOutcome: Two committed decision docs under docs/requirements/decisions/: a Tier-C threat model (pinned-key trust anchor, cross-vendor/same-operator independence ceiling, fail-closed rule table, key lifecycle) and a six-milestone execution plan (M0-M5, cheap M0-M3 vs powered M4 split).
acceptanceClaim: Both docs exist and satisfy their own acceptance criteria (the threat-model Section-6 checklist and the plan per-milestone acceptance), with the honest independence ceiling stated and no over-claim.
